name: Run, drive, legal
what: Every box (PMU box, bin box, bay junction) and every leg (L1-L4) built once to the full plan - every housing fitted, unused cavities sealed, later conductors run, capped and labelled, the later modules' dash-post plugs blanked, the PMU's later outputs off; the backbone, the EMU Black and the AEM wideband; the circuits that run the car. The factory cluster stays on its harness with an interim 52 mm GPS speedometer (D-643)
money: about $3,100-3,900 plus the EMU Black (01-engine EC01)
after: The engine's wave 1, at the same time

name: The Display Unit - the meters cutover (MG22)
what: The 12.3 in display, the BT817 board, the ICU carrier and its firmware, the road-speed sensor, the log link; the factory cluster and its harness branch go dark and leave (D-268)
after: W1 running; the DU proven on the bench (stage F)

name: The Control Unit
what: The CU (DCU carrier), its panel and face, the CUR (hazard, winks, hatch keys, mirror control), the comfort enable
after: W1; the CU proven on the bench

name: The luxury wiring
what: The doors, the HVAC servos and blower, the hatch and fuel-door releases, the radar runs, the audio and the amplifier dock; the devices are 04-luxury's
money: about $200-400 of electrical's own wire and plugs
after: W3 for the comfort enable; 04-luxury's picks
